title: test(ui-merge): the ui gate-wiring pins read the root ci.yml that runs them; pins on jobs it did not port retire
body:
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoAqVfFyhsxKuFcEP9YTBj25)_ Part of #25712 (4b PR 2d-1: the `ui/scripts/__tests__` files that read `ui/.github/workflows/ci.yml` read the root ci.yml instead, or retire). Part of objectstack#25677. Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none ## 维护者速读(草稿) - **改了什么:** `ui/scripts/__tests__` 里有 28 个测试文件读的是嵌套的 `ui/.github/workflows/ci.yml`,而这个文件在 monorepo 里根本不会运行(GitHub 只运行仓库根目录的 `.github/workflows/`)。本 PR 新增一个小 helper,按路径读根目录的 `ci.yml`。17 个文件改为断言根 `ci.yml` 里真正运行的 `type-check-ui` / `test-ui` / `build-e2e-ui` 任务;另外 11 个文件里,凡是断言对象是根目录没有移植的 objectui 任务(coverage、Build Docs、shard 汇总、timings 上传、两个选择器、turbo 缓存规则)的用例,都退役,并在原处写明由 #25697 workflow 清单的哪一行承接。其中 4 个文件没有别的内容,整文件删除。 - **为什么改:** 2d-3 要删除 `ui/.github/`。删之前这 28 个文件必须先不依赖它,否则删除时会红 28 个文件。改完以后,无论 `ui/.github/` 在不在,这 28 个文件都是绿的。 - **风险与代价(含回滚):** 只动测试和一个测试 ledger,不动任何会运行的代码、workflow 或受管面。退役的 pin 不会悄悄消失:每一条都列在下面的 follow-up 表里。其中一条是真问题:根目录 `type-check-ui` 的 Turbo 缓存保存没有 objectui#6577 的上限(把那组 pin 指向根任务,6 条里 5 条红)。按 PM 的裁定不在本 PR 里改根 workflow,只列为 follow-up。回滚 = revert 本 PR。 - **席位意见:**(留空) - **你要做的:** 无。Tier S,由席位落地。 ## 席位核对 (left for the dispatch seat) ## Why GitHub runs only the repository root's `.github/workflows/`. Since the cutover (#25825), objectui's own `ci.yml` sits at `ui/.github/workflows/ci.yml` and runs nowhere. Its four jobs that matter were ported into the root `ci.yml` by #25697: `Type Check` became `type-check-ui`, `Test` became `test-ui`, `Build & E2E` became `build-e2e-ui`, and `lint.yml`'s `Lint` became `lint-ui`. The 2d census (local, `main` `e167956e` plus 2c, with `ui/.github/` deleted; per-file table below) found that deleting `ui/.github/` reds 81 `ui/scripts/__tests__` files. Thirty of them read `ui/.github/workflows/ci.yml`. Two of those thirty, `markdown-test-inputs.test.ts` and `select-affected-tests-wiring.test.ts`, belong to #25851 and are not touched here. This PR is the other 28. The 51 files that scan the workflow directory or read other single workflows are 2d-2 and 2d-3. The rule for each pin, per the dispatcher's ruling: retarget it to the root workflow by path, or, when the root did not port its subject, retire it and name the roster row (#25697, comment 6388182608) or the root job that now carries the subject. Nothing is skipped, and nothing is folded into a root workflow here; work worth folding is listed as follow-up rows. ## What changes - **New `ui/scripts/__tests__/helpers/root-ci.ts`.** It reads `/.github/workflows/ci.yml` and never a copy under `ui/`. It provides: - `jobBlock(ci, key)`, which throws on a missing job, so a renamed job is a red pin and never an empty block; - `triggerBlock` and `withoutComments`; - `uiFilterGlobs`, the `filter` job's `ui:` paths filter, which throws on an empty list; - `globMatches` and `repoPath`; - `uiRun(alias)`, which returns `pnpm --dir ui run `, the root's spelling of objectui's commands. - **17 files retargeted** to the root jobs. The ordering pins keep their meaning inside the root job: "after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`", "before or after turbo's `type-check` task", "`fetch-depth: 0` above the step". The three path-filter pins asserted that objectui's `push` `paths-ignore` did not hide a surface. They now assert two things: the root triggers carry no path filter at all, and the `filter` job's `ui:` globs cover each surface the gate judges, which is what the job's `if:` reads. - **11 files retire pins on jobs the root did not port.** Each retirement is a comment where the pin was, naming its row. Four files had nothing else and are deleted: `coverage-shard-reporter-readability`, `coverage-shard-width`, `docs-build-trigger` and `turbo-cache-save-bound`. The pure-module cases in the other seven stay, for example `check-test-shard-results`'s budget sizing, which reads only constants. - **`ui/scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs`** drops two ledger rows: `docs-build-trigger.test.ts` (deleted) and `check-action-forward-parity.test.ts`, whose only markdown literal (`content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md`, an argument to the old matcher self-check) went with the retargeted pin. `markdown-test-inputs.test.ts` itself is not touched. Without these two removals it reports `stale-test`. ### Disposition table (28 files) | # | File | What it read in `ui/.github/workflows/ci.yml` | Disposition | Carried by now | |---|---|---|---|---| | 1 | `check-action-forward-parity` | step after install; `push` `paths-ignore` | retarget | `type-check-ui`; no trigger path filter; `ui:` globs cover every `SURFACES` file | | 2 | `check-doc-example-shared-reader` | the step | retarget | `type-check-ui` | | 3 | `check-handler-key-read-sites` | the step | retarget | `type-check-ui` | | 4 | `check-i18n-call-site-keys` | step after install | retarget | `type-check-ui` | | 5 | `check-i18n-designer-table-parity` | step after install; `paths-ignore` | retarget | `type-check-ui`; `ui:` globs cover the designer table and the gate | | 6 | `check-i18n-en-drift` | step after install; `fetch-depth: 0`; `paths-ignore` | retarget | `type-check-ui` (`fetch-depth: 0`); `ui:` globs cover the 10 packs, the ledger and the designer table | | 7 | `check-lucide-icon-record-names` | `pnpm ` anywhere | retarget | root ci.yml `run: pnpm --dir ui run ` | | 8 | `check-object-metadata-write-doors` | the step | retarget | `type-check-ui` | | 9 | `check-package-self-import` | step after install, in `type-check` | retarget | `type-check-ui` | | 10 | `check-phantom-dependencies` | step after install, in `type-check` | retarget | `type-check-ui` | | 11 | `check-unreferenced-sources` | step after install, in `type-check` | retarget | `type-check-ui` | | 12 | `check-published-tsconfig-tooling-exclude` | the step; `published-dist-gate.yml` | retarget; workflow half retired | `type-check-ui`; `published-dist-gate.yml` is roster **row 23** (kept, follow-up port) | | 13 | `check-pending-changeset-literals` | the `Decide whether this change needs a full run` exclude pathspecs | retarget | `test-ui` reads the `ui` output; `ui:` globs cover `scripts/` and `packages/` test sources | | 14 | `scripts-type-check` | `type-check` job, step after install | retarget | `type-check-ui` | | 15 | `vitest-config-type-check` | after install, before `pnpm type-check` | retarget | `type-check-ui`, before `pnpm exec turbo run type-check` | | 16 | `vitest-setup-type-check` | after `pnpm type-check` | retarget | `type-check-ui`, after `pnpm exec turbo run type-check` | | 17 | `ensure-chromium-ready` | `ci.yml` and `live-e2e.yml` use the script, no `--with-deps` | retarget; `live-e2e` half retired | `build-e2e-ui`; `live-e2e.yml` is roster **row 17** (kept, follow-up port) | | 18 | `check-doc-expression-carriage` | `node scripts/check-doc-expression-carriage.mjs` in `docs` | 1 case retired | roster **row 7 `Build Docs (@object-ui/site)`** (kept, follow-up port); the page-row pin stays | | 19 | `check-test-shard-results` | `test-aggregate` wiring; the `Test (shard N/M)` name | 8 cases retired, budget case kept | roster **row 7 `Test (the shard aggregate)`** (dropped until cutover; port with objectstack's shard attestation) | | 20 | `shard-headroom` | headroom step in `test-aggregate` and `coverage-report` | 2 cases retired | roster **row 7** aggregate and coverage | | 21 | `test-file-timings` | `test` job name, timing reporter, upload; refresh `--shards` | 4 cases retired | roster **row 28** `test-shard-timings-refresh.yml` (→ sub-issue 4; "restore Test UI's timings reporter and upload"); `test-ui`'s comment records the wait | | 22 | `select-affected-tests` | the `Select the tests this change affects` wiring | 4 cases retired | roster **row 7 `Test (shard n/16)`**: `test-ui` runs the whole suite and does not wire the selector | | 23 | `select-type-check-scope` | `tc-scope` step, `TURBO_FORCE`, root-programs build | 5 cases retired | roster **row 7 `Type Check`**: `type-check-ui` uses turbo `...[base]` and its own root-programs build step | | 24 | `report-turbo-cache` | `type-check` prune and save; every workflow's turbo cache | 7 cases retired | the four root `* UI` jobs carry objectstack's cache steps (job key, `build-core` fallback, push-only save, no prune or report); follow-up **F2** | | 25 | `coverage-shard-reporter-readability` (deleted, 4 cases) | `test-coverage` reporter flags | retired | roster **row 7 coverage** (kept, follow-up port) | | 26 | `coverage-shard-width` (deleted, 5 cases) | `test-coverage` and `coverage-report` width | retired | roster **row 7 coverage** (kept, follow-up port) | | 27 | `docs-build-trigger` (deleted, 17 cases) | `docs` job's `docs-changes` decision step | retired | roster **row 7 `Build Docs`** (kept, follow-up port) | | 28 | `turbo-cache-save-bound` (deleted, 6 cases) | `type-check`'s split, bounded cache save | retired | `type-check-ui` carries the save but not the bound; measured below; follow-up **F1** | ### Follow-up rows (fold-worthy, not done here) | Row | What | Why it is not in this PR | |---|---|---| | **F1** | Bound the root `* UI` jobs' Turbo cache saves the objectui#6577 / #7048 way: split restore and save, `timeout-minutes`, `continue-on-error`, the `cache-hit` guard, and a ceiling that leaves the verdict room. Then restore `turbo-cache-save-bound`'s pins against `type-check-ui`. | **A real finding.** Its six pins, pointed at the root `type-check-ui` job by a scratch copy, fail 5 of 6. Only "save after the last command" holds. The other five fail because the job keeps a combined `actions/cache` (the pnpm store), its save has no bound, `continue-on-error` or `cache-hit` guard, and its ceiling is 40 minutes. Fixing it is a root `ci.yml` edit (Tier H), and the dispatcher ruled no folds into root workflows in these PRs. | | F2 | Decide whether the root ui jobs run `report-turbo-cache.mjs` (prune before save, restored-key notice), or retire the script. | Root cache design is objectstack's; it clears in 2d-3 with the nested workflows). The other 25 are `date-only-zone-pins-10183` ×23 and `unit-registry-absence-collision` ×2.
